label: median verge (snow-covered grass)
contact_params_source: assumed (typical values for the material); not measured
note: At the crash site (X 56-159 m) the median is a vegetated verge: plowed snow on grass from the crash-side edge Y=-8.64 to Y=-6.94, bare grass to the far-side barrier (lit face foot Y=-4.72, right-carriageway side). No tall hedge/barrier is visible on the crash side. A low kerb or asphalt/verge lip is unresolved: the painted edge line (calibrated Y=-9.03) and ~0.26 m of asphalt are visible next to it, which bounds the verge height at its crash-side edge to <= 0.33 m; the height of the snow-covered vegetation itself is not resolvable from this single fixed view (height_m 0.15 is an estimate, height_sigma_m 0.15). Beyond X=159 m the verge ends and the median is paved, bordered on the crash side by a dark band (see related_objects: median-hedge-far). No tall 'bushy' hedge is visible next to the crash site itself: a vehicle leaving lane 1 to its left runs onto this soft verge first and reaches the barrier ~3.6 m further on.
x_range_note: visible extent of the verge: tile bottom edge at X=55.5 m (the median continues toward and past the camera, unseen), verge end at X=158.9 m (snow end 161.2, grass end 156.5). Anything drawn outside x_range is inferred.

related_objects.label: median barrier (far side)
related_objects.contact_params_source: assumed (typical values for the material); not measured
related_objects.note: Bright band Y -4.90..-4.72 on the road plane along the whole visible median (calibration line R_barrier Y=-4.80 is its centre). Read as the lit right-carriageway face of a barrier with its foot at Y=-4.72; the projected width gives height ~0.54 m (sigma 0.2). Thickness 0.3 m is assumed (the median-side face is hidden). Concrete vs steel is not resolvable at this resolution.

related_objects.label: median hedge band (far section)
related_objects.contact_params_source: assumed (typical values for the material); not measured
related_objects.note: Dark band Y -8.85..-7.69 (road-plane projection) on the crash side of the paved median beyond X=159 m; saturation 20 vs asphalt 4 and paved median 15: vegetation-like, probably a low hedge (could be a barrier in shade). Height assumed 0.5 m; its crash-side face is then at Y=-8.45. Far from the crash site (X~80 m).

paved_median_far.note: flat light-grey strip between the hedge band and the barrier; not a collision object

edge_line_check.note: profile peak of the ~0.15 m wide paint; agrees with the calibrated line within 0.05 m

measurements.method: divider.py: road-plane resampling of data/br_bg.png with cam.py; half-level crossings of lateral grey/saturation profiles
